as_of_content:
[[File:Cloaking Field portrait.png|thumb|220x220px]]
The''' Cloaking Field''' is a special relic introduced in November 2018.

==Description==
''Whether for hiding supplies, advancing undetected into enemy territory, or simply waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike, this essential piece of warfare technology is a must for any Commander.'' 

==Relic Boosts==
Increases Commander XP and Gold generation by 10% and Raid Chip rewards by 5%

==Obtainment==
20 Relic Tickets
